artifactId.description: Reference to an Artifact holding the impulse's text (NormalizedImpulse.content, or a channel's own text artifact) — the only way this capability ever sees impulse content, same discipline as document.classify/invoice.extract (an artifact ref, never raw text inline in the payload).

strategy.description: Only 'llm' exists today — no deterministic keyword/rules fallback for 'what does this impulse mean' yet (contrast document.classify's llm+keyword). Field kept, not hardcoded, so a future strategy is additive.

caseId.description: The Case this resolution belongs to, when the caller already knows it — threaded only into EvidenceWriter.write()'s originCaseId option, never trusted as a business value. Absent is valid (no Case-level loop calls this yet, docs/AUTONOMOUS-RUNTIME-V1.md część 6 krok 9).
